reviews.title: A great thing for baked goods and the oven itself
reviews.body: I bought the FibraMent pizza stone after doing some research on line.  It is my first pizza stone, and It performs wonderfully.  I used it to make Georgian khachapuri, and the crust was marvelous--crisp, blackened just a bit in spots, so flavorful--close as I could come to the cheesy bread produced in the wood-fired clay ovens in Georgia itself.  The stone also produces wonderful scones.  You need to protect the stone with parchment paper, so a pizza peel is a good thing to have to make it easy to transfer your goodies on paper onto the stone and then transfer them back onto the pizza peel to take them out of the oven.  I leave the stone in the oven as a permanent fixture, as it helps minimize temperature fluctuations (such as when you open your oven door to check on the food) and spreads heat more evenly throughout the oven.  Do make sure you check your interior oven measurements before ordering.  I was tempted to get the largest stone, but when I checked my conventional oven measurements, I found I would have to get the smallest sized pizza stone in order to leave the required inch of space between the four sides of the stone and the interior oven walls!

features: RANKED BEST OVERALL PIZZA STONE: FibraMent Pizza Stones have been ranked as the ‘The Best Overall Pizza Stone’ by Good Housekeeping, The New York Times ‘Wirecutter’ magazine, Forbes and Pala Pizza.

PROFESSIONAL GRADE PERFORMANCE: Crafted with a blend of patented high-performance materials, the FibraMent Pizza / Baking Stone ensures unparalleled durability and exceptional baking results every time.
MEASUREMENT GUIDE: Measure your oven or grill before ordering. Allow approximately a one inch (1in) opening on each side of the baking stone for proper air movement.

IDEAL HEAT DISTRIBUTION: FibraMent stones are designed to provide the ideal heat transfer rate. Experience uniform heat retention and distribution across the entire stone surface, ensuring consistent, crispy crusts and delicious results with every bake.

EASY TO USE AND MAINTAIN: Our premium baking stone is user-friendly and easy to clean. It is designed for gas, electric and convection ovens. FibraMent stones can be placed directly on your oven rack. To prevent breaking, never place baking stones in direct contact with an open flame. For grill use, always use the flame diverter under the stone.
SUPERIOR DURABILITY: FibraMent stones are thicker and more durable than other stones made from clay, ceramic, cordierite, soapstone, or granite that crack easily and bake unevenly.
USA MADE AND NSF CERTIFIED: Family-owned and made in the USA, FibraMent is independently tested and certified by NSF for safe use in baking ovens and direct contact with food.
